ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is an accelerated 8 week course and may require more time commitment per week than a traditional 16 week course. Students are required to participate in one of the two available time slots. This section will also have one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees. The ProctorU rates are $22.50 for 2 hours and $8.75 for each additional hour.1. if student wants campus exam, Brad will proctor here on campus. 2. Elluminate (Blackboard Collaborate) will be used for weekly discussion and office hours. 3. ProctorU will be used unless a student wants to come to Urbana campus to take exam with Brad.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
